about_the_game:
🖼️ Hentai Summer Swap – Digital Artbook

A vibrant visual companion for fans of Hentai Summer Swap.

Dive deeper into the world of sun-soaked waifus with this exclusive digital artbook. Featuring a curated collection of high-resolution illustrations, this deluxe PDF expands the summer fantasy beyond the puzzle board.

📚 Inside this special edition:

  • 🌴 Beautiful HD versions of the game’s artwork, presented without in-game overlays

  • 🎨 15 never-before-seen illustrations made specially for this edition

Perfect for collectors and fans who want to enjoy the visual side of Hentai Summer Swap at their own pace.

💡 After purchase, the artbook will be available in your game’s installation folder under /ArtbookDLC.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains stylized nudity and explicit sexual scenes in most of the artworks. All characters are adults.
